The July total was 838,490 contracted and 287,510 built premises.
The June 2026 Project Gigabit contract publication was updated on 20 July 2026.
BDUK's June publication reports monthly contract-level progress.
June contracted-premises figures cover the initial contract scope.
Deferred-scope premises may be absent from June contracted figures.
June management figures are not directly comparable with official statistics.
The June table is a snapshot of BDUK data held on 17 June 2026.
June data can lag contract signature or delivery because of ingestion timing.
June figures should not be used to assess contractual milestones.
June data is rounded to the nearest 10 and may not sum.
